description: This file defines types and functions related to WhatsApp identity management, including normalization, comparison, and extraction of identity information from message-like structures.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceScopedJid
methods.description: Removes device-specific suffix from JID if present.

methods.name: resolveComparableIdentity
methods.description: Resolves an identity to a standardized form with normalized JID, LID, and E164.

methods.name: getComparableIdentityValues
methods.description: Returns an array of identity values (E164, JID, LID) for comparison.

methods.name: identitiesOverlap
methods.description: Checks if two identities overlap based on their comparable values.

methods.name: getSenderIdentity
methods.description: Extracts and resolves the sender identity from a message.

methods.name: getSelfIdentity
methods.description: Extracts and resolves the self identity from a message.

methods.name: getReplyContext
methods.description: Constructs reply context information from a message.

methods.name: getMentionJids
methods.description: Retrieves mention JIDs from message mentions.

methods.name: getPrimaryIdentityId
methods.description: Returns the primary identifier (E164, JID, or LID) for an identity.
